_comment: Pinned micromamba release + per-subdir SHA256 of the official GitHub release .tar.bz2 archive.
REQUIRES the sha256 here to match before it copies the binary into resources/bin — an unpinned
or unverified binary is a supply-chain risk because it is signed/notarized with the app.
IMPORTANT: download and hash the GitHub release tarball itself. Do not use micro.mamba.pm:
it may re-package an existing version URL with different bytes and break reproducible builds.
To repin (bump `version` and `releaseTag`, then regenerate every digest below):
for s in osx-arm64 osx-64 linux-64 linux-aarch64 win-64; do
The sha256 covers the downloaded .tar.bz2 archive (before extraction). binarySha256 covers the extracted executable used by runtime preflight.
compatibility is a separately pinned final-1.x Windows runner, bundled so recovery never downloads executable code at runtime.
To repin compatibility, update its version/releaseTag, hash the official win-64 tarball, extract Library/bin/micromamba.exe, and hash that executable independently.
Before accepting a micromamba bump, revalidate the Windows managed-runtime fixtures for multi-cache search, URL-derived cache layout, and flat-cache fallback with LongPathsEnabled=0.
